4\. Ruling follow-ups refuse consultation 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Route 5 says to send an owner kit using route 4 and then run consult, but route 4 ends by running
go. If the human follows that sequence immediately, go starts a builder job and the new consult
path refuses the request while that job is queued or running.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The consultation route inherits a `go` command that makes the ensuing consultation fail its builder-busy check. ## Fix Focus Areas - docs/ARCHITECT-HANDBOOK.md[843-859] - docs/ARCHITECT-HANDBOOK.md[924-925] ## Recommended Fix Spell out when the owner kit has finished applying and when, if at all, `go` should run. If `go` is required first, instruct the human to wait for its builder job to end before issuing `consult`. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
